text:
Noah Kim: hey team, first day! quick access issues: (1) in GCP I get "Billing account not found" for project redwood-tooling, (2) in AWS my role cant list S3 buckets (AccessDenied for role Redwood-Developer). anyone know who to ping?
Riley Chan: welcome Noah! AWS first: what's your aws account id? I can check the role bindings.
Noah Kim: account id 345678901234
Riley Chan: got it. looks like you have the base dev role but not the s3:list permission. I'll attach the Redwood-Dev-S3 policy now.
Noah Kim: thanks. for GCP billing, I only see the project id; not sure which billing acct to request.
Taylor Brooks: billing links need billing.user on the billing account or we can link it for you. please open an access request at https://access.redwood.com and tag your manager. include project id and if possible the billing acct id (format BA-xxxx).
Noah Kim: filed ticket INC-9921 with project redwood-tooling and tagged my manager.
Ops Bot: Ticket INC-9921 received. Status: Pending approval from Finance. SLA: 1 business day.
Riley Chan: S3 policy attached. try `aws s3 ls` and paste the error if it still fails.
Noah Kim: `aws s3 ls` now shows buckets. woo! :tada:
Taylor Brooks: once finance approves I'll update here. tip for others: if you ever see "Billing account not found" it's usually missing project billing.link or missing billing.user on the account.
Noah Kim: awesome, really appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
onboarding-bot: Friendly reminder: complete the cloud onboarding checklist: https://onboarding.redwood.com/checklist
